title: Prospective randomized clinical trial: Surgical success rates in childhood glaucoma: Conventional probe trabeculotomy versus microcatheter-assisted 360°trabeculotomy
summary: The surgical study aims to demonstrate the superiority of microcatheter-assisted 360° trabeculotomy for primary and secundary glaucoma in children. It is a prospective, multinational, multicenter, observer-blinded randomized clinical trial (eye-pair design).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Main inclusion criteria:
- Patients with primary or secondary congenital glaucoma in both eyes
- Age ≤ 17
Exclusion criteria:
Main exclusion criteria:
- Indication other than trabeculotomy, e.g. glaucoma drainage device or cyclodestructive treatment
- previous surgical IOP-lowering interventions (i.e. cataract surgery, vitrectomy etc. are allowed)
